author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Inconsistent Checks
challenge.description: #data_dave# insists on keeping the quality checks manually done to control costs. #reliability_ruth# argues for full automation to ensure consistent results.

output.content: I am pushing for governed data quality checks across the entire pipeline. The current manual approach leaves us exposed to compliance gaps that we simply cannot afford in a production environment. I need a system where every validation step is auditable, consistent, and automatically enforced by policy. More automated governance is better, because it reduces the risk of human error and ensures that our privacy standards are met without exception. I want to see the checks move from ad hoc manual reviews to a fully governed framework that scales with our model deployment frequency. This is not a nice to have; it is the foundation for our security posture.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that more automated governance is better because it reduces risk and ensures standards are met, indicating that exceeding the minimum request for checks would increase their satisfaction.
